subject.title: Gateway becomes slow or times out under multi-session / multi-agent load

question: Should this broad Gateway liveness report stay as the canonical live-load tracker, or should maintainers close/split it into the narrower raw-transcript and defaults policy issues?
rationale: The code now has multiple partial mitigations, but the remaining user problem spans live workload proof, transcript storage policy, session defaults, and channel delivery behavior; automation cannot choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-owned live-load target that ties together Gateway RPC latency, channel delivery, session history, log tailing, and transcript growth evidence.

options.title: Split To Narrow Trackers
options.body: Close or narrow this issue only after maintainers confirm that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/66360 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85025 fully own the remaining work.

options.title: Require Fresh Live Proof First
options.body: Ask for or run a current-main live repro bundle before choosing whether this is still a broad liveness bug or only a raw-transcript/defaults policy issue.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-owned live-load target that ties together Gateway RPC latency, channel delivery, session history, log tailing, and transcript growth evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway/session performance history and product-scope context make this the best available routing candidate from the code/history trail.
